lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.active_technician_id()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/active_technician_id`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.change_technician_status(target_technician_id uuid, next_status public.technician_status, change_reason text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/change_technician_status`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
